description: The signed-in couple's own booked vendors on Zola: record that 1 booked vendor is not booked anymore, in her list of booked vendors. Get the account_vendor_id from zola_list_my_booked_vendors. Give the reason when the couple says it. It does not contact the vendor: the vendor gets no message, and the message and any promo code of the booking stay. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

account_vendor_id.description: The account_vendor_id of a booked vendor from zola_list_my_booked_vendors

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

reason.description: Why the couple unbooks the vendor, when she says it: the vendor is unavailable, the price, the style, or another reason
